Notifications

SMS & Email Templates

Notification Log (50)

This screen is read-only.

These notification templates are managed by your service operator. This screen lets you review stored wording and delivery history; it does not edit templates or enable sending.

Placeholders such as {{body}} are filled with the event's message when a notification is prepared.
The Section 129 row is the exception: its body is the statutory letter sent to the customer. Changes to that wording require legal sign-off.

Ask your service operator to arrange a reviewed template change. Sending also requires an enabled channel and its configured provider; a stored row alone does not prove delivery. SMS sending remains disabled by policy.
